notes.notes:
Hey what do you know another update.... This one includes:

- The removal of the lifts in level 1

- Fixed the lobby music restarting when you go to the levels menu

As always please leave some feedback, suggestions, and maybe even a review so that way I know what to change, what to add, and what to take away.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Waaahooo another update new things include:

-Disabled Freerun mode for further developement.

-Added overall better graphics and Global Illumination.

-Upgraded to Unity 5.6.

-Realtime lighting.

-Fixed an annoying and rage inducing bug that cause the player to stop moving in mid-air or while throwing them selves.


As always please leave some feedback, suggestions, and maybe even a review so that way I know what to change, what to add, and what to take away.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 includes multiple changes in the game such as:

- A main menu

- Menu music

- A way to earn the "Baby Steps" achievement

Things that I would like to add:

- More levels

- A "Freerun" mode

- A "Multiplayer" mode

- Better overall graphics like the water, the sun, and the buildings

Please leave some feedback on what should improve and what you think of the game.

notes.title: Released!
notes.notes:
Finally the moment that we all have been waiting for!... The release of City Rush. After a long wait of approval from Steam and new builds City Rush has finally been released. If you have the Oculus Touch then please tell me if this game works on it. If not then I will try to get support for it.

Have fun!

notes.title: Pre Release Update
notes.notes:
I have added a few things while waiting on Steam to approve my game build:

- Hands and arms instead of the normal controller model

- Achievements

- Control instructions

- Back to levels button in each level

- Sound

Things that MAYBE added:

- More modes such as freerun, multiplayer, and racing

- Timers

- Leaderboards

- More realistic graphics

- More levels

- Menu music
